name: Bamboo sticky rice
summary: Sticky rice roasted in a fresh bamboo tube, split open and eaten with sesame salt or with the grilled chicken. A tube price is Check on arrival.
origin: Bao Dak Lak names cơm lam among the foods that start in Buon Ma Thuot, with grilled chicken and jar wine.
howToEat: The Dak Lak provincial portal, 18 Feb 2019, says cooks cut young lồ ô, keep one node, add sticky rice and water, plug the tube, and roast it on fire and charcoal. Split the shell. The portal says the rice and the fresh bamboo smell stronger than sticky rice from a steamer.

Bao Dak Lak on 23 May 2023 says the sticky rice is soaked overnight, mixed with a little salt, packed into the tube, and roasted. Eat it with sesame salt, grilled pork, or grilled chicken. The 29 Aug 2016 article calls the same tube xôi roasted in nứa, soft and chewy, dipped in the forest salt that comes with the chicken. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Bao Dak Lak on 29 Aug 2016 names the Ko Tam community tourism area in the city, and Buon Tri A in Buon Don beside the Serepok. A street number for Ko Tam is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Com lam in Buon Ma Thuot — sticky rice from the tube
seoDescription: Sticky rice roasted in a bamboo tube, split and eaten with sesame salt or grilled chicken. Ko Tam and Buon Tri A are the places named. A price is Check on arrival.
